comment: Basically just makes you read the textbook and chooses random things to go over in class. You could just have the textbook and take the exam, he adds nothing. You get randomly matched with someone for important projects, if they do poorly, there is no leniency for you. He also gives extra credit if you leave positive review on Rate My Prof FYI

Carlos is a character and a great guy. He may not be the absolute best teacher in the world, but he will make sure everyone succeeds. The practices are EXACTLY the same as the quizzes/exams and as long as you pay attention in class this class will be extremely easy. you also get a cheat sheet and a premade excel cheat sheet for exams

He is a kind professor, but the course itself is quite challenging. The exams differ significantly from the quizzes. Many students find it difficult to complete tests within the allotted time because of the amount of content, and grading can be picky. Additionally, the final project is described as an easy A, but is not.
Practice tests were exactly the same as the exams. If you do the practice tests and problems you will get an A.

Gives lots of practice that helps make learning easier. There are quizzes before each test, each worth 2.5%, that cover the same topics as the exams. This makes prepping for the exams so much easier. Always accessible outside of class and cares about helping his students.
He is the best professor in B-school. This is an easy class, and he is pretty enthusiastic and easygoing. Take his class if you can!

Not only is Carlos super funny, but he truly cares about his students. The lectures can be confusing at times, but if you review the material outside of class, you'll be set up for success. His exams are fair, and his study guides tell you exactly what you need to know.

Carlos is great. The class is not difficult if you pay attention and exams were a direct reflection of what we learned in class. He was accessible outside of class and helpful if you need help. Your grade is largely exam based (roughly 50%) with 1/4 of the grade coming from a lenient final project. Would recommend.
Great teacher really nice guy and knows his stuff, easy A

The lectures can be rather confusing and a round about way of getting to the information that you actually need to answer questions. He cares more about teaching statistics than teaching how to pass the class. You need to figure out what you actually need to know and look out for mistakes since they cost a lot point wise.
Great professor
hard class, but does his best to simply material. Hes very nice and a great person, which matters the most.
Never had a teacher provide more resources to help students succeed. Exams are straightforward if you study, go to office hours, and prepare good cheat sheets. Extremely nice and very funny.

Carlos is great! He cares about his students and wants people to do well. His exams are fair, and often very similar to the practice test that he gives you. I'd definitely recommend taking this class!

Be really used to all the necessary equations or else you will definitely run out of time during the quiz and tests. Got 2 Bs until an A in final exam since I didn't manage my time well and therefore didn't have time to recheck my work. Overall easy work if you are moderately hardworking
Good class and I learned a lot, tests aren't super hard and you always get a cheat sheet. Grading rubric can be confusing sometimes with tests/MR reports b

Professor Hurtado is very passionate and cares a lot about his students. Grading is fair as long as you pay attention and contribute in class. Make sure to do the reading and meet with him to clarify anything that you don't understand before quizzes/tests.
Professor Hurtado, is one of my new favorite professors in the Bschool. The work is manageable, and there's no excuses why you shouldn't do well.

Super funny and personable, sometimes the lectures are boring, but i love that he knows we worry about grades and cares that we also get good grades. I would take him again, the content was sometimes challenging, but the assignments were relatively easy.

I really enjoyed the class overall. I had no expectations at the beginning but I had so much fun in every class. He really cares for students and it shows. His passion in the topic is amazing. Grading is very generous, and the variety of tasks makes it interesting. The class is more than you could expect!
I loved this course and the profesor made the class enjoyable and funny. I am an International student and i had fun at this class and the content was great.
Made lectures interesting, nice balance of work - quizzes, group work and exams.
Amazing teacher and a very interesting course.
I like this guy, always offering help. And quite low workload.
Great guy and great teacher
Very funny and engaging professor. Sometimes his assignments and projects are a little unclear, but nonetheless I learned a lot in his class. He was very accommodating too.

Carlos is a great guy but teaching bstats is not his calling. Everything in his class is easy until the exams, which are harder than any other assignments and are almost impossible to finish in time. Had a D most of the semester and the fact that I finished with a B is a miracle for me. Everybody I talked to had a similar experience.

Dr. Hurtado is a great teacher IF you have a significant background in stats. Otherwise, his class is confusing and his exams are very difficult. Unless you are sure that you want to be a business major and need to take his class, I would avoid him. There are better stats teachers, and for a beginner class, his class was way too difficult.
Loved his enthusiasm!
Would highly recommend!

Carlos is a mystery man. He clearly loves teaching and tries his best to engage students, but is a little all over the place and is hard to reach. If you put the work in and go to him when you can getting an A is very achievable. He scales when appropriate, too.

Carlos is great. I can understand having difficulty if you didn't have a prior background in statistics, but if you have some knowledge of confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and that stuff you'll do fine. Carlos always put a smile on my face, and his passion for statistics was evident. Also, he has great stories, ask him about them!!

Would not Carlos compared to the other possible professors for Bstats. Hes a quirky guy who is clearly smart but doesn't do a great job of teaching the content in a clear manner. Often times he would just write on the board or do computations in excel with little to no explanation. Rarely replies to emails which was the most frustrating.

He is the worst professor I have ever had. His grading of tests and assignments is inconsistent (large amounts of points are taken off for small errors), he asks for feedback and pretends to "understand" but is stubborn and changes nothing. His lectures are painfully boring and he is not very responsive. Do not take his class.

Carlos brings the energy to an otherwise boring class. He really cares about being the professor he can be. Sometimes its confusing but if you go to the student review sessions you get all the homework answers which is really helpful. Also his office hours are a must, because he will clearly explain it you a lot better than in class.
I love professor Carlos. Down to Earth guy! He is all about his student. I had 2 classes with Carlos. He is super accessible out of the classroom.

Carlos is an extremely friendly professor who really cares for students. His homework is reasonable although he requires you to use managerial report format. Overall if you put effort that is appropriate for a normal course, you will get a good grade you want. Also, please make use of his teaching assistant. Don't panic if you fail the test.

Carlos was a pretty good professor. I think that in order to do well in his course it is definitely important to go to office hours. He offers a bunch of extra credit to students and he really wants you to do well so if you put in the effort you can definitely do well in his class.

His class is really enjoyable and clear. It is important to pay attention to details and he gives many extra credits to students. In addition, the class practices are useful and similar to the real exam problems. Please be patient when Professor Carlos tries to help you understand the concepts and you will learn a lot with his explanations.

Carlos' office hours are the best way to get an A if at first you're struggling. Going over problems with him 1 on 1 is an entirely different experience to in class lectures. He is so nice and cares about students like no professor I've ever had. I knew nothing about statistics before but his outside help is why I was able to end with an A.

Carlos is great. At first I was unsure of the class because he has a somewhat unorthodox method of doing homework and testing. But, if you engage with him, and actively seek advice/help, he will do everything in his power to help you succeed. His teaching style is applicable to real world jobs, and he will help you become proficient in Excel.

Carlos is a great teacher and an even better guy. If you put in the effort it is a very manageable class and you will learn a lot. I specifically gained great experience in excel which is great as a finance major.

Carlos is the nicest professor I've ever met at the University of Richmond. His homework and tests are not difficult. If you work hard enough, you can definitely get an A. The workload is not too much. If you have any questions, you can come to Carlos and he would help you as much as possible.

He was a pretty good lecturer. The homework assignments were pretty difficult, but he was always available if you need help with it. While the tests were difficult Dr. Hurtado always made it very clear what would be on them and for my class they were open book. Hard class but if you put the effort into the class you can definitely get an A.

Carlos is a great prof: accessible and helpful office hours and lots of extra credit. Just have to watch vids/takes notes/skim the textbook and you'll be fine. Those that don't do well put 0 effort in. He's also funny and tries to connect w/ students. No surprise questions on the already easy exams: just prepare decently and it's an easy A

He cares about his students, gives a lot of extra opportunities and is clear about what he wants from you with every exam. To succeed, make sure you do the practice problems over and over again, the exams stay true to what is taught in class. His lectures might drag on but just watch the assigned videos and you should be fine.
I do believe the reviews underestimate Carlos. He cares so much for his students and their learning process.

He is a unique professor. He treats students nicely and gives them many chances to improve their grades. He makes the whole learning process less stressful. His lectures are clear and understandable you just have to pay attention at the time. No surprises at tests and quizzes.
Solid econ elective
Super nice professor and even easier class. It can be difficult at times but as long as you do the work an A is guaranteed. A lot of extra credit and he always is willing to take feedback

I regret taking this class with him at UR- it has been pointless. He is a very sweet guy who is available outside class-time, and he does "meme competitions" every week, but he can not teach this subject in a clear manner. Grading is unclear as well, and he lectures terribly. If you want to learn anything or enjoy your class, stay clear.

He gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. His quizzes and tests can be difficult but if you meet with him in office hours and go over things you should be good. He is a new professor so he is still getting used to things.

Dr. Hurtado lacks the self-awareness and teaching ability for his classes to be even somewhat an enjoyable learning experience. His quizzes and exams do not relate to his dry and boring lectures. He means well, but that does not show in his teaching ability.

He is a nice guy but not great with teaching the content. He does not give much homework which makes it tough to know what to expect in the final exams or even the quizes. His quizes are long and he does not give enough time for them. He is helpful outside of class. Not a tough grader though.
He doesnt communicate very clearly but its not a hard class. He gives so much extra credit and you will learn a little bit of bstats. Really helpful one on one. Not hard at all
